fields.name: Packing & Unpacking
fields.description: Professional packers use high-quality materials to securely wrap and box items, while movers can also unpack them at your new location.

fields.name: Loading & Unloading
fields.description: Movers use proper lifting techniques and equipment to safely load your belongings onto the truck and unload them at your destination.

fields.name: Disassembly & Assembly
fields.description: Experienced movers can disassemble large items like beds and reassemble them at your new home.

fields.name: Specialty Item Moving
fields.description: Expertise and equipment to safely transport valuable or delicate items like pianos, artwork, and large appliances.

fields.name: Storage Solutions
fields.description: Temporary or long-term storage facilities for belongings that need to be stored during a move.

fields.name: Post-Move Services
fields.description: Services like arranging furniture, mounting TVs and portraits, and cleaning up moving debris.

fields.name: Laboratory Relocation
fields.description: Professional services for moving sensitive and high-value lab equipment and materials, as well as office relocations.
